mapper.insert: INSERT INTO house (house_number, building_name, floor, owner_id, status, created_at, updated_at, water_fee, power_fee, price, area, images) VALUES (#{house_number}, #{building_name}, #{floor}, #{owner_id}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), #{water_fee}, #{power_fee}, #{price}, #{area}, #{images})
mapper.update: UPDATE house SET owner_id = #{owner_id}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE house_number = #{house_number}
UPDATE house SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE house_number = #{house_number}
UPDATE house SET water_fee = #{water_fee}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE house_number = #{house_number}
UPDATE house SET electricity_fee = #{electricity_fee}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE house_number = #{house_number}
UPDATE house SET power_fee = #{power_fee}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE house_number = #{house_number}
mapper.select: SELECT id, house_number, building_name, floor, status, price, area, images FROM house
